decisions.topic: Coordinator ruling 2026-11-10 (p-inter-84): task 22 frame rate and caption time labels
decisions.ruling: Supersedes items (1) time labels and (2) of the task-22 rulings, after the deeper source trace (training_strategies.py:23/219-224/259/166 read the training videos' own FPS; diffusion.py:171 and run_training_videodrive.py:119 hard-code past_seconds, future_seconds = 2.0, 4.0). (2') FRAME RATE: keep the released standalone inference behaviour (pipeline default 25; frame_rate not passed), because the training FPS of the released weights is not public and the released inference is the authors' shipped setting. Do not pass 8 or 10. Disclose it. Guard: the DEV A1 time-scale check (generated vs real ego speed ratio in the first 0.4 s and 0.4-0.8 s, as for Wan2.2) must lie in [0.8, 1.25]; if it does not, STOP and report. Never switch the rate on the basis of DEV calibration results. (1') CAPTION TIME LABELS: use the only code-evidenced caption builder literally: past 2.0 s, future 4.0 s, and compute its numeric fields over the same 2.0 s of real history (AV2 ego poses t0-2.0..t0; speed and acceleration at t0), so that every number is true for the stated window. The model still sees only the last 1.0 s of frames (9 at 8 Hz). No driving command. Both passes use this one prompt verbatim. Disclose: labels from the training caption builder, not from the frame counts.

decisions.topic: Coordinator ruling 2026-11-10 (p-inter-84): task 22 codec assembly, reference policy and caption numbers
decisions.ruling: APPROVED as proposed, following the frozen LTX-2.5 two-stage precedent (protocol-ltx25d2s-v1.md L2-L4; same LTX codec family): (a) Generated clip: real history 17 frames at 8 Hz (t0-2.0..t0) VAE round trip seeded seed_of(w,'prefix'); native65 = prefix[:8] + pass1[0:33] + pass2[9:33]; the history and t0 frames of each clip are its own decoded pass-1 conditions (per-clip prefix, as LTX L3). Keep all passes. (b) Reference: VAE round trips of the real 33-frame segments t0-1.0..t0+3.0 and t0+2.0..t0+6.0, seeded seed_of(w,'recon') and seed_of(w,'recon') + 1000003, the same prefix and the same assembly and 8 -> 10 mapping, posterior sampling and decode settings exactly as the official pipeline (normalisation, decode_timestep 0, tiling); so real and generated clips share the segment seam at t0+3.0 s. Disclose that the decoder is non-causal (decoded history and t0 frames depend on the later frames of their segment), as for LTX. (c) Gates and checks as LTX: t0 association per clip with v1.1's window rule (export --t0-rule window), DEV gate at most 5 % of (window, family) pairs dropped, sensitivity --t0-rule clip; the time-scale guard [0.8, 1.25] of the earlier ruling; a decoder noise-floor diagnostic on a few DEV references (reported, not a gate). (d) Caption numbers: approved: displacement (forward, lateral, yaw) from pose(t0-2.0) to pose(t0) in the t0 ego frame; planar speed from the last 0.5 s of poses; acceleration = norm of the difference between the last and the preceding 0.5 s velocities over their actual time gap; all pose rows at or before t0; no navigation command. Disclose that these are finite-difference proxies for the training data's vehicle-state speed and acceleration norms.

decisions.topic: Coordinator ruling 2026-11-10 (p-inter-84): task 22 missing vendored diffusers models package
decisions.ruling: Diagnosis (checked): the repository root .gitignore at 243e0e4 has the pattern 'models/' (comment 'Model checkpoints (too large for git)'), which also excludes the vendored DriveLaW-Video/Infer/diffusers/src/diffusers/models package: a packaging accident upstream; no issue or alternative source exists, and the HF repo holds weights only. Ruling: reconstruct the package from upstream huggingface/diffusers, pinned by evidence, not by guess. (a) Identify the upstream diffusers commit the vendored tree derives from: compare the 699 shipped files (outside models/) by content hash with upstream history around 0.37.0.dev0; report the best commit, the counts of identical and differing files, and the list of every differing file (these are the authors' modifications). If no commit matches all unmodified files exactly, report the closest and STOP. (b) Take src/diffusers/models from that exact commit (record its sha and every file hash); nothing from other versions. (c) Before any GPU: static check that every class, method and keyword argument the vendored pipeline, infer.py and infer.sh use on the transformer and the VAE exists in the reconstructed package with the same signature; check whether DriveLaW-Video/Train defines or patches model classes (if the transformer or VAE was modified for training, STOP and report). After the licence OK and the download: strict state-dict loads of transformer and VAE with zero missing and zero unexpected keys, then the RS smoke. (d) Disclose in the draft: the models package was reconstructed from upstream diffusers <sha> because the release omitted it through .gitignore. (e) Do not post an issue on GitHub or contact the authors: that is outward-facing and needs the owner's decision.

decisions.topic: Coordinator ruling 2026-11-10 (p-inter-84): task 22 diffusers base selection
decisions.ruling: Selected base: huggingface/diffusers ebf891a254de807bd88aba8a09792c82df74f459 (models tree e0a58748ef1a371a9716fef4e43a5653121e4e6b). Reason: both equal-best commits match all 697 unmodified shipped files byte for byte; the only commit between them, ebf891a (PR #12832, 'gracefully error out when attn-backend x cp combo isn't supported'), touches attention_dispatch.py and modeling_utils.py for the attention-backend x context-parallel validation, which single-GPU inference without context parallelism does not use. Condition: show the exact git diff 8af8e86...ebf891a of those two files and confirm that it changes neither the default attention path (native SDPA dispatch) nor from_pretrained / state-dict loading; if it does, STOP and report instead of using it. Record both candidate shas, both tree shas, the diff and this reason in the pins and the draft (disclosed: the original base cannot be distinguished between the two by the shipped files). The authors' only change remains pipeline_ltx_condition.py; keep it as shipped. The training-source audit and the strict state-dict load (after the licence OK) remain required before any GPU run.
